# crowbar-sdk

> Public format and tools to make a PS4RT runtime (a native port of a PS4 game) compatible with the Crowbar launcher: trophies, profile, catalog downloads and updates. MIT licence. No Crowbar code inside.

Optional since SDK 1.2: pause from Crowbar's Guide menu (`"pause": true`, files in PS4RT_CONTROL_DIR, `crowbar_poll()` / `crowbar_answer()`; SPEC.md section 4).
Optional since SDK 1.3: unlock on request for Crowbar's trophy test profile (`<n> unlock <id>` in the same files, `CROWBAR_UNLOCK` / `crowbar_request_trophy()`; keep extra trophy state in PS4RT_ACHIEVEMENTS_DIR when set).

An AI assistant asked to make a runtime Crowbar compatible should follow AGENTS.md: run `crowbar-check . --handout`, add `crowbar.json` and a `crowbar_unlock(id)` call in the sceNpTrophyUnlockTrophy handler, repeat `crowbar-check . --json` until `"ok": true`, then show the diff without publishing anything.

## Docs

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/DiamondDogz/crowbar-sdk/blob/main/AGENTS.md): step-by-step procedure and rules for AI assistants
- [SPEC.md](https://github.com/DiamondDogz/crowbar-sdk/blob/main/SPEC.md): crowbar.json, the trophy file, environment variables, catalog entry
- [README.md](https://github.com/DiamondDogz/crowbar-sdk/blob/main/README.md): overview for developers

## Code

- [sdk/c/crowbar.h](https://github.com/DiamondDogz/crowbar-sdk/blob/main/sdk/c/crowbar.h) and [crowbar.c](https://github.com/DiamondDogz/crowbar-sdk/blob/main/sdk/c/crowbar.c): `crowbar_unlock(id)` in C99
- [sdk/python/crowbar.py](https://github.com/DiamondDogz/crowbar-sdk/blob/main/sdk/python/crowbar.py): the same in Python
- [schema/crowbar.schema.json](https://github.com/DiamondDogz/crowbar-sdk/blob/main/schema/crowbar.schema.json): JSON Schema of crowbar.json
